findings.issue: Kana reads 何か as なんか, but the item's own expl_en/expl_pt teach the target as なにか ('The target is なにか'). Canonical reading of 何か as indefinite pronoun in polite register is なにか; kana contradicts the lesson target.
Token 何 has reading なん, contradicting the explanation and the token's own role text ('base de なにか'). Should be なに to match the taught form なにか.
Romaji follows the incorrect なんか reading; should follow なにか per the item's stated target (distinct from the known punctuation/katakana romaji issue).
幸せ is labeled 'núcleo' (head) of 幸せのしるし, but it is the modifier; the head is しるし. Contradicts the pattern used elsewhere (e.g. 映画館 = 'modificador (de スクリーン)', 茶 = 'núcleo de お茶').
findings.current: modificador (núcleo de 幸せのしるし)
